# pve_node_apt_repositories (Data Source)

Retrieves the parsed APT repository configuration of one node (`GET /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories`): every repository entry from the parsed sources files, the standard repositories and their configuration status, and any parsing warnings or errors. `repositories` rows are flattened with their containing `path` and zero-based `index` within that file, matching the coordinates the upstream repository-change endpoint expects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Parsed APT repository configuration of node pve1.
data "pve_node_apt_repositories" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

# Optionally fetch a package changelog alongside the repository state.
# data "pve_node_apt_repositories" "pve1_changelog" {
#   node    = "pve1"
#   package = "pve-manager"
# }

output "pve1_standard_repos" {
  value = { for repo in data.pve_node_apt_repositories.pve1.standard_repositories : repo.handle => repo.status }
}

output "pve1_repository_rows" {
  value = [for repo in data.pve_node_apt_repositories.pve1.repositories : "${repo.path}[${repo.index}] enabled=${repo.enabled}"]
}

output "pve1_apt_file_errors" {
  value = [for err in data.pve_node_apt_repositories.pve1.errors : "${err.path}: ${err.error}"]
}

# output "pve1_pve_manager_changelog" {
#   value = data.pve_node_apt_repositories.pve1_changelog.changelog
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node whose APT repositories to read.

### Optional

- `package` (String) Package name to additionally fetch the changelog for (`GET /nodes/{node}/apt/changelog`). When set, `changelog` carries the package's raw changelog text; when unset, `changelog` is null.

### Read-Only

- `changelog` (String) Raw changelog text of `package` as reported by the node. Null when `package` is not set.
- `digest` (String) Common digest of all parsed repository files; usable as an optimistic-concurrency guard on repository changes.
- `errors` (Attributes List) Repository files that could not be parsed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--errors))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source (the node name).
- `infos` (Attributes List) Additional information and warnings for the APT repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--infos))
- `repositories` (Attributes List) Every parsed repository entry, flattened across files in file order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))
- `standard_repositories` (Attributes List) All standard repositories known to PVE and their configuration status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--standard_repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--errors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `errors`

Read-Only:

- `error` (String) The error message.
- `path` (String) Path of the problematic file.


<a id="nestedatt--infos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `infos`

Read-Only:

- `index` (String) Index of the associated repository within the file, as a string.
- `kind` (String) Kind of the information (e.g. `warning`).
- `message` (String) Information message.
- `path` (String) Path of the associated file.
- `property` (String) Property from which the info originates.


<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Associated comment.
- `components` (List of String) Repository components. Empty for `.sources` entries without components.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the repository is enabled.
- `index` (Number) Zero-based position of the entry within its file.
- `options` (Attributes List) Additional options of the entry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories--options))
- `path` (String) Path of the file containing the repository entry.
- `suites` (List of String) Package distributions (suites).
- `types` (List of String) Package types of the entry. Values: `deb`, `deb-src`.
- `uris` (List of String) Repository URIs.

<a id="nestedatt--repositories--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories.options`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Option key (e.g. `Signed-By`).
- `values` (List of String) Option values.



<a id="nestedatt--standard_repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `standard_repositories`

Read-Only:

- `handle` (String) Handle identifying the repository (e.g. `enterprise`, `no-subscription`).
- `name` (String) Full name of the repository.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the configured repository is enabled. Null when the repository is not configured.
